results.angle: The developer who must build this: phone theme on Expo SDK 57 / RN 0.86 (tokens module, button, sheet, toast, motion helpers) and panel CSS on Vite 8 / React 19, from tasarim.html alone. Checked against the page CSS/JS, color.js, spring.js, the shot report and plan/teknik.

findings.where: #katmanlar 'Alt sayfa.' + #etkilesim row 'sheet' ('giriş yay orta (384 ms oturur, panel yedeği linear())') vs #platform iOS 'Alt sayfa' ('Açılış ve kapanış hareketi sistemindir; süresi ve eğrisi token değildir') vs #hareket Süreler 'genis 300 ms' ('Alt sayfa ve yan panel girişi') vs #acik 01
findings.problem: The phone bottom sheet has four incompatible motion specs: withSpring orta 384 ms + exit 200 ms (Katmanlar, Etkileşim, Özet 'alt sayfa orta ile açılır'); genis 300 ms (Süreler); system motion that is not a token (Platform, TrueSheet = UISheetPresentationController / Material BottomSheet, which a Reanimated spring cannot drive at all); and 'alt sayfa sistemin kendi hareketiyle mi açılır' listed as undecided (Açık nokta 01). The spring version also breaks the document's own rule 'çıkış girişten kısadır (oran 0.67 ile 0.75)': 200/384 = 0.52. Yaylar says the web fallback keeps 'aynı süre' (384 ms) but the demo CSS falls back to --dur-genis 300 ms. The first real question a developer hits.
findings.fix: Pick one. With TrueSheet: #etkilesim sheet row 'Süre: sistem (TrueSheet); Azaltılmış: sistem'; remove 'Alt sayfa' from the uses of genis, orta (200) and spring orta; Özet 'alt sayfa sistemin hareketiyle açılır'; label the web sheet as illustration; keep Açık nokta 01 for the panel drawer only. If a custom sheet is wanted, drop TrueSheet and give the exit a duration that meets the 0.67 to 0.75 rule.

findings.where: Hero meta 'Bu sayfadaki her renk, ölçü ve süre tokens.json dosyasından gelir'; #etkilesim 'Değerler tokens.json içindeki patterns dizisinden gelir.'; #hareket Yaylar 'spring.js ile üretilen linear()'; #kutuphaneler-ortak 'tek bir DTCG 2025.10 token dosyasında durur'
findings.problem: The cited source of truth is not delivered: the repo gets only tasarim.html; tokens.json, spring.js, tcheck.js, color.js, coverage.js, shot.js live in a scratch folder. The tokens.json the page was built from is a custom schema (name, undertone, color.neutral[{step,L,C,H,hex}], patterns), not the DTCG file Kütüphaneler mandates, so 'tokens.json' names two different files. The text never shows DTCG token paths or one $type/$value example (OKLCH object + hex fallback, {value, unit}, cubicBezier, 3-number spring group), never lists att.* tokens (att.gorevli.fg etc. appear only as names in the Kontrast table), and never lists the reduced-motion and high-contrast token files. The tokens module and the Style Dictionary config cannot be written without scraping the page CSS.
findings.fix: Commit tokens/ beside tasarim.html (DTCG .tokens.json, reduced-motion and contrast override files, spring.js, color.js, tcheck.js) or add a 'Token dosyası' section printing the full DTCG JSON; name that path in the hero line; add an att.* and status.* table with OKLCH and hex.

findings.where: #kutuphaneler-telefon 'durum değişimleri CSS tarzı geçişlerle yazılır' vs #hareket Yaylar 'efekt ... Renk ve opaklık (telefon)' and Kurallar 08 'renk ve opaklık yay efekt ya da süre tokenı ile'
findings.problem: Two drivers for the same phone patterns, never resolved per component. Kütüphaneler: press, color, visibility use Reanimated CSS-style transitions with cubic-bezier tokens. Yaylar: color/opacity use spring efekt (272 ms); tab indicator and press release use spring hizli (282 ms) while #etkilesim 'tab' (both platforms) says 'gösterge uzun 240 ms', standart, and 'press' releases in mikro 100 ms; toast and list move use spring orta (384 ms) while #etkilesim gives toast 'giriş orta 200 ms ... giris / cikis' and list 'yer değişimi uzun 240 ms'. Kurallar 08 says 'ya da'. Kütüphaneler 'Basma geri bildirimi' adds a third press duration: '100 ile 150 ms'. The motion helpers cannot be written without guessing.
findings.fix: Add a 'Telefon' column to #etkilesim naming exactly one driver per pattern (CSS-style transition dur+ease, withTiming, or withSpring name); delete the spring usage lines that disagree; replace '100 ile 150 ms' with 'mikro 100 ms'; remove 'ya da' from Kurallar 08.

findings.where: #etkilesim row 'success' 'stroke-dashoffset (kare ve onay çizimi), transform: scale (yay imza)' vs #kutuphaneler-telefon 'Köşeli onay işareti düz View çubuklarıyla çizilir'

Technique contradicts (SVG stroke drawing vs View bars animated by transform and opacity only; the stroke animation also breaks #hareket Kurallar 01 'Yalnız transform ve opacity canlandırılır'). Delete the View-bars sentence.

findings.where: #hareket Kurallar 10 'renk ve opaklık 100 ile 150 ms kalır'; #erisilebilirlik 'Animasyonları kaldır: değişim anında; opaklık geçişi de yoktur'; #kutuphaneler 'kısalır ya da sıfırlanır'
findings.problem: Reduced-motion values are never listed per token. Dialog, toast, banner say only 'Yalnız opaklık' and the demo plays them at 200 ms, outside 100 to 150. Android removes fades, iOS keeps them, but the hook is one boolean and the table keeps fades. Stack: 'fade' (#platform), 'fade ya da none' (#kutuphaneler), prefersCrossFadeTransitions() (#erisilebilirlik). Toast: 'kendiliğinden kalkar' (#kutuphaneler) vs 'Yalnız opaklık' (#etkilesim). Loader keeps an 'opaklık nabzı' that Kurallar 09 bans ('nabız ... kullanılmaz'). No mechanism makes springs follow a live change (ReduceMotion.System reads Reanimated's own flag; ReduceMotion.Never is banned).
findings.fix: Add a reduced token table (each dur to its reduced value), one Android rule (reduce on Android: 0 ms), one stack rule ('fade' when the hook is true), an explicit loader exception or a static mark, and the way the live hook value reaches Reanimated.

praise: Colour restraint is exactly what the owner asked for. Measured over the whole page in slices at 1440: off-white and white 94.0%, gray 5.45%, midnight blue 0.44%, yellow and green 0% (390: 89.5 / 9.7 / 0.63 / 0). The app screens hold 0% to 6.24% blue, all within budget.

Motion matches the spec to the millisecond (read via getAnimations): menu 150 ms in and 110 ms out, dialog 200/150, sheet 384 ms spring in (linear()) and 200 ms out, toast 200, tab indicator 240 and content 110. Under reduced motion, menu, dialog, sheet, toast, tab, switch, checkbox, banner and scan all become opacity-only.

The phone screens and the panel table look like real product UI at Carbon level. The numbered usage-map phone plus the Röntgen toggle answers 'where does midnight blue go' better than any of the analog docs.

No console errors and no page-level horizontal overflow at 390 or 1440. All 859 interactive elements have 0 px radius and a transition. The focus ring is a crisp 2 px with a 2 px offset, focus returns to the trigger after Escape, and the OTP error and success states work.

results.angle: Owner constraints (O1 to O7, O3b, O3c) and the Turkish: plain wording, terms consistent with plan.html, no dashes, no marketing or English filler, no repeated facts
praise: The yellow and green ban holds in the rendered page. I wrote my own computed-style audit (out/review1/lang/colors.js): it walks every element and its ::before, ::after, ::marker and ::placeholder at 390 and 1440 px. It found 34 unique painted colours and none in the banned 35 to 220 hue range. coverage.js on every section screenshot also gives yasak %0. The research file has 0 banned paints as well.

Gece mavisi nerede answers the owner's 'nasıl ve nerede' question directly. It has an 8-role usage map (role, place, step, reason), a never list, a lesson timeline and per-screen measured shares against a stated budget, with a Röntgen toggle. All six screens are within budget (highest: the success screen at %6,24 of %7).

Every :hover rule sits inside @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine), with 0 unguarded rules. There is no text-transform anywhere. The live tr-TR casing demo renders İSTANBUL ILIK IĞDIR and ışık correctly.
Status names, receipt states, record tags, AKSİS labels and all four warning sentences match plan.html word for word.
Forum quotes in R08 and R09 of the research file are all 15 words or fewer (0 over the limit).

The per-component radius list has no radio entry, #ozet still says '0 px, bütün bileşenlerde', and the İkonlar caption calls the round control an icon to get around the rule.

Or reuse the list-row selection already in Seçim (neutral.5 ground, 2 px mark, check icon). Remove radio_button_* from the 48-icon list and delete the 'işareti de bir ikondur' sentence.

findings.where: #ozet 'Hareket süreleri': 'Odak halkası 0 ms.'; #panel caption: 'sıralama ve süzme animasyonsuzdur.'; #ilkeler 03: 'odak halkası ve klavyeyle yapılan sık işler anında olur'
findings.problem: O5 names focus and lists among the interactions that must animate smoothly, each with a duration, a curve or spring, and a reduced-motion behaviour. The owner wrote 'paneller butonlar her şey için'. The doc ships a 0 ms focus ring with 'Eğri: yok', instant table sort and filter (#kutuphaneler adds 'tablo anında yeniden dizilir'), and İlkeler 03 contradicts its own headline ('her şey hemen ve yumuşak bir geçişle') one line later. Açık nokta 03 mentions focus only in passing and never mentions sort or filter, so the owner is never asked about these exact deviations.
findings.fix: Either animate them: the focus ring enters with opacity 0 to 1 and outline-offset 4 to 2 px over 100 ms mikro, exits at 0 ms, and stays 0 ms under reduced motion; filter and sort crossfade the tbody opacity over 150 ms kisa, instant under reduced motion. Or keep them instant: retitle Açık nokta 03 to 'Odak halkası, tablo sıralama ve süzme anında kalsın mı?', list the three deviations, and reword İlkeler 03 to match until the owner answers.

findings.where: #kutuphaneler, Web paneli table, row 'Grafik': 'oranlar meter ve düz SVG ile çizilir.'
findings.problem: Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari all paint the native <meter> green for the optimum value and yellow for the suboptimum value, and accent-color does not affect it. Following this row puts green and yellow into the panel's devam oranları (Y4), which the owner banned ('kesinlikle olmayacak'). dgate.js and tcheck.js cannot catch it, because the colour comes from the browser's own stylesheet.
findings.fix: Use the doc's existing 4 px bar instead (a div with role='meter' and aria-valuenow/min/max, accent.11 on neutral.4) and add '<meter> kullanılmaz' to #renk. If <meter> stays, specify appearance: none and set ::-webkit-meter-bar, ::-webkit-meter-optimum-value, ::-webkit-meter-suboptimum-value, ::-webkit-meter-even-less-good-value and ::-moz-meter-bar each to a token.

findings.where: #durumlar heading 'Uyarı düzeyleri' and labels 'Düzey 1/4' to 'Düzey 4/4'; #ekranlar Bugün card label 'Düzey 2/4'
findings.problem: plan.html calls this concept 'seviye' (anchor #devam-uyari-seviyeleri, 'seviye değişince', 20 uses) and uses 'düzey' only in 'ders düzeyinde'. tasarim.html introduces 'düzey' 32 times, including in student-facing text, while its own Özet table says 'Uyarı seviyelerinin metinleri' and its panel toast says 'devam seviyesi'. One concept now has two words on screen, which fails D12 (consistent terms, the plan's voice).
findings.fix: Use 'seviye' wherever it means warning level: heading 'Uyarı seviyeleri', on-screen label 'Seviye 2/4', the #erisilebilirlik 1.4.1 row 'Uyarı seviyeleri', and the scale caption 'bölmeler uyarı seviyesini gösterir'.

findings.where: #renk, Nötr ölçek table, neutral.12 Görev cell: 'Birincil metin; ters yüzey (bildirim, çevrimdışı şeridi); Elle eklendi'
findings.problem: Everywhere else the offline band is light neutral.3 (the #gece-mavisi never list, #katmanlar, the #etkilesim banner row, and the CSS comment 'never the dark inverse band'). Toasts are bg.surface (.toast and .ptoast use var(--bg-surface); the never list says 'bildirimler beyaz yüzey'). A developer working from the colour table would paint a near-black band across the top of phone screens and near-black toasts, the opposite of 'ana tonlar gri ve kırık beyaz'. That also leaves bg.inverse and its dependent roles with no named user.
findings.fix: Set the neutral.12 Görev cell to: 'Birincil metin, güçlü ikon, Elle eklendi mürekkebi, kamera zemini, örtü'. Then either name the real users of bg.inverse, text.onInverse, text.onInverseSecondary, border.inverse and focus.ringInverse, or drop them from Anlam rolleri and from the 75-pair table.

findings.where: #platform iOS 'Alt sayfa': 'Açılış ve kapanış hareketi sistemindir; süresi ve eğrisi token değildir.'
findings.problem: The same component gets three answers. #katmanlar ('Giriş yay orta (384 ms, aşma yok)... Çıkış 200 ms'), the #etkilesim sheet row, #hareket Yaylar ('Alt sayfa, bildirim, liste yer değişimi (telefon)') and #ozet Yaylar ('alt sayfa orta ile açılır') all specify a tokenised spring. #platform says TrueSheet's native motion is not tokenised. #acik 01 says it is undecided ('alt sayfa sistemin kendi hareketiyle mi açılır'). Under D13 a developer cannot tell what to build.
findings.fix: State it once, in #katmanlar: 'Telefonda TrueSheet sistemin hareketiyle açılır ve kapanır; süre ve eğri token değildir. Uygulamanın içinde çizilen yedek sayfa ve bu belgedeki örnek: yay orta, çıkış 200 ms.' Remove the phone spring from the #etkilesim sheet row, the 'orta' usage line and #ozet Yaylar. Keep Açık nokta 01's question only if the owner really has to choose.

findings.where: #kutuphaneler, Web paneli row 'Yazı tipi barındırma': 'kullanılacak: 5.3.0 (Inter için, tam sabit)'; Telefon row 'Yazı tipi', Risk: 'Aile tipografi kararında seçilecek'
findings.problem: The family is decided (IBM Plex Sans 3.201 and Plex Mono, #tipografi). This install row tells the developer to pin @fontsource-variable/inter and shows Inter's npm numbers, and the phone row says the family is still to be chosen. This is stale research text inside a decision table, and following it ships the wrong font.
findings.fix: Under Seçim, list the Plex packages actually used (for example @fontsource-variable/ibm-plex-sans, plus @fontsource/ibm-plex-mono at 400 and 500) with their measured versions and their own Ölçüm figures. Delete 'örnek: @fontsource-variable/inter', 'Inter için' and 'Aile tipografi kararında seçilecek'.

findings.where: #kutuphaneler, Web paneli row 'Tarih seçici': 'bu, uygulamanın telefon ve tarayıcı ayarını izlediği plan kararıyla uyumlu.'
findings.problem: plan.html#hoca says 'Panel Türkçe dil ve Türkçe biçimle çalışır'. Its 'follow the browser settings' decision covers text size and contrast, not date format. A US-English browser shows 10/06/2026, which contradicts the plan, and #acik 05 of this same document says exactly that. The row misstates plan.html (D11 requires no contradiction with the plan).
findings.fix: Replace with: 'Görünen biçim tarayıcının dilinden gelir; bu, planın Türkçe biçim kararıyla çelişir (bkz. Açık noktalar 05).'

findings.where: #durumlar 'Sunucu kararları ve makbuz', Ret: 'Gerekçe koduyla. Makbuz QR'ı ile yeniden denenebilir.'
findings.problem: plan.html#kararlar-kayit-ve-makbuz: 'Kayıt zaten ulaştıysa hangi yoldan gelirse gelsin "zaten var" döner'. A Ret decision means the record has reached the server, so scanning its receipt cannot retry it. The receipt path exists for a send that never arrived (#kararlar-yeniden-deneme). The line promises a recovery path the product does not have.
findings.fix: 'Ret: gerekçe koduyla. Öğrenci 3 gün içinde Sorun bildir ile bildirir (plan.html#kararlar).'

findings.where: #ozet 'Başka belgede karar verilenler': 'burada yeniden yazılmaz, bağlantı verilir'
findings.problem: The table lists QR colour, quiet zone and scanning as decided in plan.html, then the doc rewrites them. #ekranlar 'QR kuralları' has 'Her kenarda en az 4 modül boşluk' and 'panelin olası koyu teması QR'a uygulanmaz'. #renk Anlam rolleri has 'her yanda dört modül boşluk'. #erisilebilirlik 'QR gösterimi' says 'Burada yalnız erişilebilirlik ayrıntısı var' and then restates colour and size. Other plan facts restated: the 24 px target (#bicim, #erisilebilirlik), paste and autofill (#bilesenler, #kutuphaneler Form durumu), the 3-day report window (#katmanlar), and 1x and 2x zoom (#ekranlar). This breaks D11 and the header's own rule, 'Her bilgi tek yerde durur'.
findings.fix: Delete the restated plan rules and leave one link for each. Keep only the design values plan.html does not have: qr.dark #000000, qr.light #FFFFFF, a 328 dp plate on a 360 dp screen, and a 0 ms change. Cut the 'QR kuralları' card down to 'Renk, boş kenar, değişim aralığı ve yakınlaştırma: plan.html#asama23'.

findings.where: tasarim-arastirmasi.html #r03-k02, rejected option: 'Carbon onları 'enthusiastic, ...' hareket için tanımlıyor'
findings.problem: The second adjective in this quote is on the owner's banned-word list, and dgate.js warns on it. Rubric R5 requires no banned words in the research file.
findings.fix: Paraphrase it in Turkish: 'Carbon ifade eğrilerini coşkulu ve canlı hareket için tanımlıyor; akademik araç tonuna uymuyor.'

findings.where: #platform Web paneli paragraph 'Tarayıcının kendi öğeleri.'; #erisilebilirlik canlı bölgeler row 'Uzun iş (Excel hazırlama)': '10 saniyeyi geçerse progress öğesi'
findings.problem: The panel relies on native select, the native date input and <progress>, and sets no accent-color (0 hits in the CSS). Safari on macOS draws checked native controls and progress bars in the user's system accent colour, which can be green or yellow. That brings banned hues into the panel without any token.
findings.fix: Add ':root { accent-color: var(--accent-fill); }' to the panel base CSS, list it under Anlam rolleri (accent.fill), and state that popups drawn by the OS keep the OS colours as the only exception.

findings.where: #ekranlar captions 'Ö2, Ö5', 'Ö13', 'Ö3', 'H14'; #panel 'P2 · P8'; #durumlar 'Durum metinleri': 'Ürün özetinde adı geçen ama ekranı çizilmemiş durumların metni'
findings.problem: The screen codes (Ö2, Ö3, Ö5, Ö6, Ö7, Ö13, Ö15, H1, H5, H14, P1, P2, P8, P12, D1; 15 uses) and the phrase 'Ürün özeti' come from brief.md in the scratchpad. plan.html and teknik.html contain none of them, and the header explains only the R and L ids, so a cold reader of the repository cannot decode them (D13). P2 is also wrong for the attendance table: it means 'Ders ve program'.

findings.where: #ust: 'her renk, ölçü ve süre tokens.json dosyasından gelir'; #kontrast: '75 çift · tcheck.js PASS'; #etkilesim: 'tokens.json içindeki patterns dizisinden gelir'; footer

The document never says where they go in the repository, or that they will be added. findings.where: #ozet Neden column: 'Sahibin kilidi, 6 Ekim 2026'; #platform: 'Biz çizeriz'; #acik decision lines: 'Sahip.'
findings.problem: 'sahip' appears 57 times and is never defined. plan.html never uses it: its voice is impersonal, with the first person singular where a person speaks ('bunu ben değiştiremem', 'modülüm'). This doc also switches to the first person plural ('Biz çizeriz', 'kendi kodumuz', 'kancamız', 'bizim' 14 times). For faculty reading the repository, 'Sahibin kilidi' sounds like a third party, and D12 asks for the plan's voice.
findings.fix: Say once in the header who decides and when the colour lock was set. After that, write rules as decisions ('Kilit, 6 Ekim 2026: sarı ve yeşil yok'), replace 'biz' and 'bizim' with impersonal forms ('uygulama çizer', 'uygulamanın kendi katmanı'), and in Açık noktalar use 'Karar: proje sorumlusu' or the plan's own form.

findings.where: #platform iOS 'Sistem ayarları': 'Kontrastı Artır: ... tokenlarda yok, açık nokta.'
findings.problem: #erisilebilirlik 'Artırılmış kontrast' defines exactly this variant: a second role mapping, the iOS signal isDarkerSystemColorsEnabled, and the @media (prefers-contrast: more) block. #acik has no such open point. The sentence is stale, so the reader gets both 'yok' and a full mapping.
findings.fix: 'Kontrastı Artır: ikinci rol eşlemesi devreye girer (bkz. Erişilebilirlik, Artırılmış kontrast).' Delete 'tokenlarda yok, açık nokta'.

findings.where: #kutuphaneler 'Çözülen çelişkiler' (d): 'sonner 2.0.8, bildir() sarmalayıcısının arkasında; yedek Base UI Toast.'
findings.problem: Item (d) gives Sonner as the resolution ('Yerel öğe kararına bu tek istisna'). The Web paneli 'Bildirim (toast)' row says no library. The closing paragraph overturns (d) ('Sonner yerine tarayıcının canlı bölgesi Üç kör eleştirmenden ikisi...', with no punctuation after 'bölgesi'). #acik 04 asks the owner. That is three answers in one section, plus remarks about blind critics in a repository document.

findings.where: #etkilesim accordion row, Çıkış: 'içerik solar, alan kapanır' (uzun 240 ms); #kutuphaneler 'Yükseklik açma kapama', Risk: 'hedeflerde anında kapanır'
findings.problem: The interaction table promises an animated close, but the library table says the native details element closes instantly in every target browser. The owner asked for open and close animation on everything (O5). One of the two is wrong and the developer cannot tell which.
findings.fix: Pick one. To keep O5, close through a small helper: animate content opacity and grid-template-rows from 1fr to 0fr, remove [open] on transitionend, and close instantly under reduced motion; say so in the row. Otherwise change the accordion row to 'Çıkış: anında' and add this to the deviations in Açık nokta 03.

findings.where: #bilesenler, Düğmeler caption: 'Birincil düğmeye basınca 1,8 sn yükleniyor durumu gösterilir'
findings.problem: The page script sets aria-busy and swaps the label the moment the button is clicked, yet #katmanlar 'Yükleniyor' and the #etkilesim loading row say '1 sn altında gösterge yok'. Developers copy demos, and this one teaches the opposite of the rule. '1,8 sn' also reads like a product value.
findings.fix: In the demo, delay the busy state by 1000 ms so it shows only while the fake job is still running. Change the caption to 'İş 1 saniyeyi geçerse düğme yükleniyor durumuna geçer; örnek iş 1,8 sn sürer.'

findings.where: #katmanlar menu #m1: 'Makbuzu okut', 'Excel olarak indir Ctrl E', 'Kaydı sil'; #bilesenler Tehlike row 'Kaydı sil'
findings.problem: In plan.html the receipt QR is scanned by the instructor's phone ('Hoca okutunca telefonu...'), not in the web panel. Records are corrected with reason codes and kept for audit (teknik.html: düzeltmeler 'silinmez'), and there is no delete-record action. Ctrl+E is the browser's search shortcut in Chrome, Edge and Firefox. The demo invents three product features that a reader will take as decided.
findings.fix: Use plan actions only: 'Düzeltme ekle', 'Sorun bildirimini aç', 'Excel olarak indir'. For the destructive example use 'Yoklamayı erken kapat'. Drop the shortcut, or pick one that browsers do not reserve and record it under Erişilebilirlik.

findings.where: #bilesenler Seçim, Anahtar: 'Bildirimler · Gönderilmemiş kayda günde bir hatırlatma.'
findings.problem: This shows an in-app switch that turns reminders off. plan.html has no such setting (the daily reminder is a decision), and the doc itself says 'uygulamaya ayrı titreşim ayarı konmaz, telefonun ayarı izlenir' and 'Uygulamada ayrı hareket ayarı yok'. Demo labels read as product decisions.
findings.fix: Replace it with a toggle the plan already backs (Devamdan muaf is already shown) or a filter switch such as 'Yalnız İncelemede göster', and keep demo labels to plan features.

findings.where: #ekranlar 'Akış' 01: 'Yoklamamı ver (Aşama 2'de kamerayı açar; bağlantı belgede yazılmamış)'
findings.problem: plan.html does not decide how 'Yoklamamı ver' relates to QR scanning in Aşama 2. The doc decides it inside a parenthesis and in the same breath says it is not written down, without saying which 'belge'. An undecided product flow belongs in #acik, not inside a caption.
findings.fix: Remove the parenthesis from the flow card and add an open point: 'Aşama 2'de Yoklamamı ver kamerayı mı açar, QR okut ayrı bir düğme mi?', with the proposal and a link to plan.html#asama23.

findings.where: #gece-mavisi role 3: 'gövde metninden yalnız 2,38:1 ayrılır'; #erisilebilirlik: 'Gövde yazısıyla farkı 2,42:1'
findings.problem: color.js gives #2B58B1 on #1A2030 as 2.42:1. The 2,38 figure, copied from context.md, cannot be reproduced, on a page that says its ratios come from a script. One pair now has two numbers.
findings.fix: Use 2,42:1 in role 3 and in the 'Satır içi bağlantı' rows, and keep one number in #ozet 'Gece mavisinin rolü'.

findings.where: #tipografi Kurallar: 'Satır oranı metinde en az 1.25 ... yalnız rakam satırında 1.2.'
findings.problem: The doc's own tokens break this rule. Phone 'etiket 13/16 pt' (status stamp text, section labels) has a ratio of 1,23, and panel 'rakam 42/50 px' has 1,19, both below the stated floors. The rule and the tokens disagree (D13).

findings.where: #bicim Çizgiler, 'ince': 'telefonda StyleSheet.hairlineWidth'; Yükselti table: '1 dp ince çizgi'
findings.problem: hairlineWidth is one physical pixel, about 0,33 dp on a 3x phone, not 1 dp. A 1,43:1 card edge drawn that thin nearly disappears on mid and low-end Android screens, and the two statements disagree.
findings.fix: Use 1 dp (StyleSheet value 1) for border.subtle on the phone and delete hairlineWidth, or keep the hairline and change the Yükselti row to 'tek fiziksel piksel'.

findings.where: #durumlar 'Renk körlüğü denetimi': 'Renkli üç mürekkebin (Var, Yok, Görevli) en yakın çifti Görevli ile Belgeli düzeltme'
findings.problem: Belgeli düzeltme is not one of the three coloured inks. In the table, the closest coloured pair is Var and Görevli (0,093). The overall minimum, setting aside the intentional 0, is Görevli against the two neutral statuses (0,089).
findings.fix: 'Renkli üç mürekkebin en yakın çifti Var ile Görevli (0,093); bütün çiftlerde en küçük uzaklık Görevli ile iki nötr durum arasında (0,089, eşik 0,02).'

findings.where: #erisilebilirlik 'Renk tek başına anlam taşımaz': 'kırmızı yalnız Yok, Ret, hata ve hak aşımındadır.'
findings.problem: Red also carries warning level 3 'Hakkın kalmadı' (before any overrun), the Tehlike button variant ('Kaydı sil', 'Yoklamayı kapat') and the error border on fields. 'yalnız' is false, and the reader will look for a rule the design does not follow.
findings.fix: 'Kırmızı: Yok, Ret, hata, hakkın bittiği ve aşıldığı uyarılar (seviye 3 ve 4) ve geri alınamayan işin düğmesi.'

findings.where: #gece-mavisi Hiçbir zaman: 'hiçbir durum mürekkebi 220 ile 290 ton aralığında değildir'; same list: 'kenarlıklar ve ayırıcılar (tek istisna panelin anahtar rakamı)'
findings.problem: The 'Sunucuya ulaştı' stamp is accent.11 (role 7), so a status other than Var sits in the family. Every neutral ink is also in that hue range (#1A2030 at H 268,2, #596074 at H 270,0), because the family is defined by hue together with chroma of at least 0,04, not by hue alone. The Var and Sunucuya ulaştı stamps have 1 px accent.11 borders, so the borders line is false as well. The never list is the owner-facing contract and must be exact.
findings.fix: 'Var ve Sunucuya ulaştı dışında hiçbir durum gece mavisi ailesinde değildir (ton 220 ile 290, kroma 0,04 ve üstü).' and 'Kenarlık ve ayırıcı gece mavisi olmaz; istisnalar: seçim işareti, işaretli kutu, Var ve Sunucuya ulaştı damgalarının çerçevesi.'

findings.where: #ozet Durum renkleri: 'Görevli mor'; #erisilebilirlik: 'Renklerin anlamı sabittir.'
findings.problem: Purple carries the warning family (warning level 2, İncelemede, status.warning #7839A5), but it also carries Görevli (#652F94), a positive excused status. In the panel table, Görevli and İncelemede sit in adjacent columns in nearly the same purple. That contradicts 'Renklerin anlamı sabittir' and invites reading Görevli as a problem.
findings.fix: Give Görevli a neutral ink like Belgeli düzeltme, with the work icon and the word carrying the meaning, or keep purple for Görevli only and move warning to low-emphasis red. Then list the colour meanings in one place.

findings.where: #panel summary card and tab: 'Karar bekleyen 3 · İncelemede 2, Beklemede 1'
findings.problem: plan.html uses 'KARAR BEKLİYOR' for the end-of-term AKSİS result of a student whose status is unresolved. Reusing the same words for 'records with an İncelemede or Beklemede server decision' gives one phrase two meanings in the same panel.
findings.fix: Label the card and the tab with the plan's own names, 'İncelemede ve Beklemede', or a word the owner approves that is not 'karar bekleyen'.

findings.where: #platform Web paneli: 'Tarayıcıda yerel bildirim öğesi yok'; #katmanlar: 'Bildirim. Bağlantı dönünce...'; #katmanlar dialog: 'Yerel dialog öğesi.'
findings.problem: plan.html uses 'bildirim' for OS notifications (bildirim izni, yerel bildirimler) and for 'sorun bildirimi', and teknik.html says 'tarayıcının kendi öğeleri'. This doc calls the toast 'bildirim' and the browser's native toast 'yerel bildirim öğesi', which in the plan's sense reads as 'local notification'. It calls native elements 'yerel öğe' ('yerel öğe kararı'). The Sorun bildir sheet then says 'Bildirim hocanın listesine düşer' right next to a toast also called 'Bildirim'.
findings.fix: Call the toast 'kısa bildirim' everywhere (the library row already says 'Kısa bildirim (toast)'). Call native elements 'tarayıcının kendi öğesi', as teknik.html does. Use 'yerel bildirim' only for OS notifications.

findings.where: #bicim Yükselti: 'scrim neutral.12 yüzde 48'; #platform Android: 'Hareketle gezinmede perde yok'; #erisilebilirlik: 'Sık tabloda Yok ve Ret'; #platform Android: 'kırık beyaz sekme çubuğuyla'
findings.problem: Several things have more than one name. The scrim is called scrim, örtü and perde. The dense table is 'yoğun tablo' 6 times and 'sık tablo' once. 'kırık beyaz' is defined as the neutral.2 page ground but is also applied to the tab bar and the TrueSheet background, which are bg.surface (neutral.1). The neutral.12 ink is called 'grafit', 'nötr mürekkep', 'gri mürekkep' ('kalan süre gri mürekkep') and 'birincil metin rengi'. Percentages are written both as 'yüzde 48' and '%48'.
findings.fix: Use örtü everywhere (code name scrim) and 'yoğun tablo' only. Use 'kırık beyaz' only for neutral.2 and 'yüzey' for neutral.1. Call the neutral.12 ink 'birincil metin rengi'. Write percentages as '%48'.

findings.where: #gece-mavisi 'Bir ders boyunca gece mavisi' caption: '(110 dakikalık dersin %13,6'i)'
findings.problem: The suffix follows the spoken number: 'yüzde on üç virgül altı' takes '-sı', so '%13,6'i' is wrong.

findings.where: #ozet 'Rakamlar' row: 'Yüzde işaret önde: %69,5.'
findings.problem: The possessive suffix is missing, so the phrase is ungrammatical.
